recipes.title: Homemade Farfalle with Sausage and Olive Sauce
recipes.summary: Make fresh bow-tie pasta, then cook it with a savory sausage and olive sauce, finished with lemon, butter, and burrata.
equipment: Large bowl or clean work surface

steps.text: Create a well in the center of a mound of flour on a clean work surface.
Pour the egg yolks into the center of the flour well.
Use a fork to gently whisk the egg yolks.
Gradually incorporate small amounts of flour from the sides into the egg yolks, mixing with the fork.
Use a bench scraper to mix the flour and egg yolks until a shaggy dough forms.

terms.meaning: A dough that looks rough and uneven, with bits of flour and liquid not fully combined yet.

steps.text: Knead the dough on the work surface until it forms a smooth, elastic ball.
steps.done_cue: The dough should be smooth and springy when pressed.

terms.meaning: To work dough by repeatedly folding, pressing, and stretching it to develop gluten and make it elastic.

steps.text: Pass the dough through a pasta machine, gradually thinning it into long sheets.
Use a fluted pastry wheel to cut the pasta sheets into small rectangles.
Cut each rectangle in half diagonally to create two triangles.
Pinch the center of each pasta triangle to form a bow-tie shape (farfalle).
Place the shaped pasta on a tray to dry slightly.
Drain and finely chop the green olives.
Remove the Italian sausage from its casings.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
steps.done_cue: The oil should shimmer slightly.

steps.text: Add the sausage meat to the hot pan, breaking it into smaller pieces.
Cook the sausage, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through.
steps.done_cue: The sausage should be crumbly and no longer pink.

steps.text: Add the chopped green olives to the pan with the sausage.
Stir to combine the olives with the sausage.
Pour the chicken broth into the pan.
Bring a separate pot of salted water to a rolling boil.
steps.done_cue: The water should be bubbling vigorously.

steps.text: Add the fresh farfalle pasta to the boiling water and cook until al dente.
steps.done_cue: The pasta should be firm to the bite.

terms.meaning: Italian for 'to the tooth', meaning pasta is cooked until it is still firm when bitten, not soft or mushy.

steps.text: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked pasta directly into the pan with the sausage and olive sauce.
Squeeze the juice from half a lemon over the pasta and sauce.
Add pieces of butter to the pan.
Toss the pasta, sauce, lemon juice, and butter together until well combined and the butter is melted.
Serve the pasta onto a plate.
Top with spoonfuls of burrata cheese.
Garnish with fresh oregano leaves.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: A simple and quick stir-fry recipe with chicken and broccoli, perfect for a weeknight meal.

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Place the chicken pieces in a large bowl.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch to the chicken.
Mix well to coat the chicken, then set aside to marinate.

terms.meaning: to soak food in a seasoned liquid to add flavor and tenderize it

steps.text: In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of cornstarch, and 1/4 cup of water.

terms.meaning: to beat or stir a substance, especially eggs, cream, or sauce, with a light, rapid movement

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
steps.done_cue: The oil should be shimmering slightly.

terms.meaning: a large, bowl-shaped frying pan used in Chinese cooking

steps.text: Add the marinated chicken to the hot pan and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned.
steps.done_cue: The chicken should no longer be pink inside.

terms.meaning: to cook food quickly by frying it in a small amount of oil over high heat while stirring constantly

steps.text: Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and set it aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the pan.
Add the broccoli florets to the pan and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
steps.done_cue: The broccoli should be bright green and slightly softened but still have a bite.

steps.text: Add the minced garlic and ginger to the pan with the broccoli.
Stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
steps.done_cue: You should be able to smell the garlic and ginger.

steps.text: Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the broccoli.
Give the prepared stir-fry sauce a quick whisk to recombine, then pour it over the chicken and vegetables.
Stir constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
steps.done_cue: The sauce should be glossy and cling to the ingredients.

steps.text: Serve the chicken and broccoli stir-fry immediately, perhaps with rice.

tips: You can adjust the amount of sugar in the sauce to your preference.
For extra spice, add a pinch of red pepper flakes with the garlic and ginger.
gaps: The number of servings is not stated.
The total cooking time is not stated.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.summary: A popular Indian lentil dish, cooked in a pressure cooker and finished with a flavorful tempering.

steps.text: Add toor dal, masoor dal, turmeric, salt, oil, and 1.5 cups of water to a pressure cooker.

terms.meaning: Dried lentils or split peas, a staple in Indian cuisine.
A type of split pigeon peas, commonly used in Indian cooking.

steps.text: Close the pressure cooker and cook for 5 whistles on medium-high heat.
steps.done_cue: The cooker will release steam and make a whistling sound.

steps.text: Let the pressure release naturally, then open the cooker and mash the dal.
steps.done_cue: The dal should be soft and slightly broken down.

steps.text: Add 1 cup of water to adjust the consistency and mix well.
steps.done_cue: The dal should be smooth and pourable.

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp of ghee in a pan over medium heat.
steps.done_cue: The ghee should be melted and shimmering.

terms.meaning: Clarified butter, used for cooking and flavoring.

steps.text: Add cumin seeds, asafoetida, and 2 dried red chilies. Sauté for a few seconds until fragrant.
steps.done_cue: Cumin seeds will sizzle and become fragrant.

terms.meaning: A pungent spice, also known as hing, used in Indian cooking.

steps.text: Add the bay leaf and sauté briefly.
Add crushed garlic, ginger, and 1 slit green chili. Sauté until fragrant.
steps.done_cue: Garlic and ginger will become aromatic.

steps.text: Add the finely chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
steps.done_cue: Onions turn translucent and then golden.

steps.text: Add the finely chopped tomato and sauté until soft and mushy.
steps.done_cue: Tomatoes break down and become soft.

steps.text: Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Sauté for a minute.
steps.done_cue: Spices are well combined with the onion-tomato mixture.

steps.text: Pour the cooked dal into the pan with the tadka mixture.
Mix everything well and bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
steps.done_cue: The dal thickens slightly and the flavors combine.

steps.text: Add chopped coriander leaves, crushed kasuri methi, and garam masala. Mix well.

terms.meaning: Dried fenugreek leaves, used for flavor in Indian cooking.

steps.text: In a small pan, heat 1 tsp of ghee over low heat.
steps.done_cue: Ghee is melted.

steps.text: Add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Let them splutter.
steps.done_cue: Cumin seeds sizzle and pop.

steps.text: Add 1 dried red chili and 1/4 tsp chili powder. Stir quickly.
steps.done_cue: Chili powder dissolves in the ghee.

steps.text: Add 1 tsp finely chopped coriander leaves and turn off the heat.
Pour this tempering over the cooked dal.
steps.done_cue: The tempering is drizzled over the dal.

steps.text: Mix well and serve hot.

The duration for sautéing onions and tomatoes is not specified.

recipes.title: Indian Style Egg Fried Rice with Egg Parcel
recipes.summary: Flavorful egg fried rice with a unique sauce-filled egg parcel, a fusion of Indian and Chinese tastes.

ingredients.name: Basmati rice
ingredients.note: soaked for 20 minutes, then cooked and chilled

steps.text: Cook the rice, then chill it in the fridge for 1.5 hours.
steps.done_cue: Rice is chilled and not sticky.

steps.text: While rice chills, chop all vegetables: onions, carrots, cabbage, green chilies, ginger, garlic, and spring onions.
steps.done_cue: All vegetables are finely chopped.

steps.text: Add oil to a pan and heat it.
steps.done_cue: Oil is shimmering.

steps.text: Add chopped garlic and ginger to the hot oil and sauté until fragrant.
steps.done_cue: Garlic and ginger are fragrant.

steps.text: Add carrots and stir-fry for a minute.
steps.done_cue: Carrots are slightly softened.

steps.text: Add cabbage and green chilies, and stir-fry until they are slightly darker.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are slightly charred.

steps.text: Add salt and sugar to the vegetables and mix well.
steps.done_cue: Salt and sugar are incorporated.

steps.text: Add French beans and stir-fry.
steps.done_cue: French beans are added.

steps.text: Add the cooked rice to the pan with the vegetables.
steps.done_cue: Rice is added to the pan.

steps.text: Carefully fold the rice with the vegetables, ensuring everything is mixed well.
steps.done_cue: Rice and vegetables are evenly mixed.

steps.text: Add light soy sauce and white pepper powder.
steps.done_cue: Soy sauce and pepper are added.

steps.text: Add chopped spring onions and mix gently.
steps.done_cue: Spring onions are added and mixed.

steps.text: Add optional white sesame seeds.
steps.done_cue: Sesame seeds are added.

steps.text: Make space in the pan, crack 3 eggs into the space, and stir them until moist.
steps.done_cue: Eggs are cooked and moist, mixed with vegetables.

steps.text: Pour the prepared sauce mixture into a separate pan and heat it.
steps.done_cue: Sauce is simmering.

steps.text: Add the chopped green chilies, capsicum, ginger, and garlic to the sauce pan.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are added to the sauce.

steps.text: Stir-fry the vegetables in the sauce briefly; do not overcook.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are lightly sautéed in sauce.

steps.text: Pour the thickened sauce mixture over the fried rice and gently fold to combine.
steps.done_cue: Sauce is evenly distributed in the rice.

steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk 3 eggs with 2-3 tbsp water, salt, and chopped coriander leaves.
steps.done_cue: Egg mixture is well whisked.

steps.text: Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
steps.done_cue: Oil is hot.

steps.text: Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture into the pan, making it thicker in the center and thinner at the sides.
steps.done_cue: A thin, even egg layer is formed.

steps.text: Once the omelette is cooked, tilt the pan and carefully remove it onto a cutting board to cool.
steps.done_cue: Omelette is cooked and removed from pan.

steps.text: Once cooled, place the fried rice on a plate.
steps.done_cue: Rice is on the plate.

steps.text: Carefully place the cooked egg parcel on top of the fried rice.
steps.done_cue: Egg parcel is placed on rice.

steps.text: Cut the egg parcel and let the sauce coat the rice.
steps.done_cue: Sauce has coated the rice.

steps.text: Garnish with a coriander sprig.
steps.done_cue: Dish is garnished.

tips: Always chop vegetables before cooking the dish for even cooking.
Ensure vegetable cuts match the main ingredient (rice grains) for better texture.
Cabbage is used to increase volume and save cost; it can char itself.
